name: Zero-inflated models (ZIP / ZINB)
when_to_use: Count dependent variable with excess zeros beyond what Poisson or Negative Binomial predicts.

expected_input.question: How to model counts with excess zeros?

plain_explanation.purpose: Predicts counts when there are excess zeros, treating 'never happens' separately from 'sometimes happens'.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When most items have zero and you need to understand why there are so many zeros.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A column of counts with many zeros and factor columns.
plain_explanation.example: Count accidents per company, where many companies never have any because of safety policy.
plain_explanation.diagram: item -> is it in the 'always zero' group? yes: 0 | no: normal count (0, 1, 2...)
